label: Divine justice JUSTICE_1 route to permitted divine assertion 1457
summary: Analyst reconstruction of ST I q.21 aa.1-2, 4 in docs/notes/divine-justice-1457.md, attribution deferred. Verified zero-axiom routes: will-only-approved plus approval-tracks-order give JUSTICE_1 (every willed act Fitting); JUSTICE_1 plus assertion-is-willed plus fitting-assertion-permitted give the existing veracity premise GodAssertionsPermitted (new conditional support option, not a discharge). Voluntarist reading of Fitting yields JUSTICE_1 for every will profile, so under it the route reduces to divine-command permission and gives the veracity norm no independent support; voluntarism is kept as a standing rival, not refuted. Controls: joint sample with an actual assertion, four omission samples, JUSTICE_1 without JUSTICE_2 (unwilled due act), and voluntarist/independent divergence on one profile. Afflicted-just objection bears on JUSTICE_2, and on JUSTICE_1 only via an unencoded withholding-is-unfitting premise. GodIsSupremelyGood is not used. Open: GodWillsOnlyApproved, GodApprovalTracksOrder, GodAssertionIsWilled, FittingAssertionPermitted. Next tests: Fitting-to-form/end due bridge (DEF-FORM-END-DUE-PERFECTION), mercy as beyond-due compatible with JUSTICE_1, link to q.19 will vocabulary (#1459). No computed premise change expected beyond the new support option.
